PagerBot: :rotating_light: [AUTOPAGE] High 5xx error rate detected on inference-edge-us-west (rate > 3% over 5m). Paging on-call.
Kai: seeing this alert too. dashboards show spike starting ~1743219600. Any quick mitigations? :eyes:
Maria: I can jump on it. Noticed increased Nginx 502s coming from gateway-proxy-01 -> inference-gateway clusters.
PD Bot: PagerDuty incident INC-95231 created and routed to Oncall Rotation. Auto-ack filter: noise-threshold=2m, but this one passed.
Oncall Rotation: acked INC-95231 @1743219900 — taking ownership.
Lee: quick check — KV cache warmup logs show a burst of cache misses. Could be cold-start amplification.
Kai: curl to health endpoints shows some pods returning 502 quickly. Past 10s: `502  by inference-gateway`.
Maria: rolling logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T21:12:03Z] gateway: upstream response error: EOF
[2026-03-14T21:12:04Z] worker: failed to open kv: timeout
[2026-03-14T21:12:07Z] gateway: 502 serving /v1/chat
```
Sam: any traffic change? Is this customer ramp or internal synthetic traffic?
Kai: Netflow shows a sudden increase from one IP range (AS-64512) — looks like a partner load-test hitting us.
Maria: I see a big batch job hitting long-context endpoints with seq_len ~4096. Those amplify KV miss costs.
Lee: Immediate mitigations we can do now:
- Enable model fallback to smaller variant (mismatch tolerated) for edge region
- Turn on request-level throttling for the source IP CIDR
- Warm a few more inference pods (scale up pool)
Kai: I'll push a very small canary: route 30% of traffic for that IP to model-quantized-v2 as fallback.
Maria: Doing throttling rule now:
```
rbac-throttle add --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --rate 50r/s --burst 100
```
(Oncall Rotation): Applied throttle at 1743220200. Observing rate drop.
PD Bot: Note: auto-escalation to manager if unacked for >15m — currently acked.
Lee: Starting scale-up: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-pool-us-west --replicas=12` — warmup in progress.
Sam: After throttle + fallback + scale, 5xx% dropped from 4.8% -> 1.1% in the dashboards. Still slightly above baseline.
Kai: Any customer-facing impact? Zendesk shows one open ticket, but error sampling shows majority from partner IP. No broad customer alerts yet.
Maria: I'm going to add a temporary routing rule to prefer cached-KV instances for long-context requests.
Lee: Adding fallback to lower-memory quantized model to all instances in us-west — config applied at 1743220700.
PagerBot: :white_check_mark: Fallback policy applied: model-quantized-v2 for route /v1/chat/long-context (30% traffic for matching CIDR).
Oncall Rotation: Preparing handoff notes for next on-call in 30m. Summary: Partner load test -> KV miss amplification -> applied throttle + model fallback + scale -> partial recovery. Need follow-ups: partner coordination, improve prefix caching, rate-limits for long-context routes.
Sam: I'll open a post-incident ticket and tag partner ops. Drafting now: INC-95231 followup -> P0? probably P1.
Maria: Quick runbook check: runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-kv-miss
Lee: Add metric alert refinement: only alert if 5xx > 2.5% AND error count > 200 in 5m to reduce noise.
Kai: Logging note: capture `x-client-id` in 502 logs for next 24h so we can correlate to partner.
Oncall Rotation: Handoff: I'm going offline at 1743222000, leaving Sam as primary until rotation takes over.
PD Bot: Incident INC-95231 updated: status=monitoring, responders=[Oncall Rotation, Kai, Maria], priority=P1.
PagerBot: :information_source: Postmortem checklist to be created within 72h. Tagging Eng-ML + SRE.
Maria: quick command I ran to verify KV miss rate:
```
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=kv_miss_ratio&region=us-west' | jq .value
# returned 0.42 -> 42% KV miss for long-context bucket
```
Sam: Leaving notes in the incident ticket with timestamps and mitigations performed.
Kai: TL;DR for next on-call: watch for partner CIDR, have throttling playbook ready, consider proactive warming for long-context bursts.
Oncall Rotation: signing off to handoff channel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: :lock: Incident INC-95231 will auto-resolve if metrics are stable for 20m. Current monitoring continues.
Maria: will follow up with partner ops and schedule a focused postmortem. +1 to adding guardrail in gateway for seq_len>2048.
Lee: I'll open a PR for the alert thresholds and prefix caching improvements.
Sam: closing thread here, keeping ticket open for follow-up.
